name: Vegas Town
rootCause: The attacker launched a continuous attack on the EOS quiz game Vegas Town, profited thousands of EOS, and has been transferred to the ZB exchange. Preliminary analysis found that hackers used the failed (hard_fail) transfer transaction to cheat the game server, resulting in continued awards.
